visualObservations: Both actual original PNGs and both first-failed output snapshots were opened. Final actual SVG draft screenshots were opened at 358 and 716 px media widths.
Figure 192 has both circles, all five source points O/A/M and O/A, both secants in a, radius and tangent p in b, and the source right-angle marker only in b.

Figure 193 has all three source panels, all 14 labelled source points, four full source circles, the partial auxiliary-circle arc through B1/O/B2, all source construction/tangent links, single/double equality ticks in a, and single tangent ticks in c.

The final screenshots are nonblank and legible. Neutral circle and tangent strokes are distinct from thin solid construction strokes. No right-angle squares were added to figure 193; no O-M links were added to c; no A-O link was added to b.

Source facts and text-justified modern clarity are separate in source-inventory.json. Exact radius/tangent and auxiliary-circle relationships are executable, not inferred from a similar-looking output.

Standalone SVG media widths were actually measured at 331/358/640/716 px, with no text overlap or clipping. This is not evidence of measurements in the live application. At 358 px the measured minimum text size is 18 px; at 331 px it is approximately 16.642 px.
Screenshot page whitespace below the mobile figure 192 is the fixed 1000 px test viewport, not excess SVG canvas height. The actual media is 358 by 560 px; figure 193 is 358 by 950 px.
